problem: It says 'The metering unit, or FADEC (full authority digital engine control), sets the flow'. The metering unit and FADEC are not the same thing. FADEC is the electronic control system (computers plus a hydromechanical unit); the metering unit is the hardware that actually meters fuel, and it is commanded by the FADEC. A student will write that FADEC is a fuel-metering valve in the exam.
fix: Write: 'The metering unit, commanded by the FADEC (full authority digital engine control), sets the flow for the thrust demanded. FADEC is the control system; the metering unit is the valve it drives.'

problem: The figure leaves out the fuel filter that the Section 1 text puts in the path, so the diagram and the text show different fuel paths. A student revising from the picture alone will miss the filter and its bypass.
fix: Add a 'Fuel filter' node with note 'bypass if blocked' between the HP pump and the metering unit, so the figure matches the text.

problem: Density in kg/L is not the usual unit; a student may substitute kg/m³ from a data table and get an answer 1000 times wrong. The oil formula is fine but the unit convention is not stated for the SI case.
fix: Keep ṁ = ρ × V̇ but add: 'With SI units, ρ in kg/m³ and V̇ in m³/s. With ρ in kg/L, V̇ must be in L/s.'
